text: Inquiries | Contact Us | Ajinomoto Group Inquiries Please enter your inquiry after confirming the conditions below. Depending on the inquiry, we may not be able to respond immediately, or we may reply by phone. We may not be able to reply to every inquiry. For inquiries to Ajinomoto group companies, click here. Depending on the inquiry, an Ajinomoto group company may reply to you. In such cases, your personal data information will be jointly utilized among and within the relevant group company . After you send your inquiry, you will receive an automatic confirmation by email. If you do not receive confirmation,please click here . The reply is for the use of the recipient only. Please do not transfer or publically disseminate all or any part of the reply. Required fields missing Please use alphabets, numbers, spaces and symbols （@ - + * / ^ \ ! " # $ % & ' = ~ |` ? _, . ; : () { } < > [ ] ）only. Nature of Inquiry: Please select Nature of Inquiry Please Select Consumer Foods Consumer Foods (sold in Japan) Food Ingredients Amino Acids (for pharmaceuticals and foods) Amino Acids (for feed use) Specialty Chemicals Sweeteners Human Resources Investor Relations Others ･ For media inquiry, please click here. Please see if the confirmation email is in your Deleted Items or Junk email folder. Is your e-mail program is set to reject specific addresses? Please change the setting to allow to contact you, and then resend the contact form. Please do not email our address above. It is not encrypted with SSL, so your personal information will not be secure. Did you mistyped you email address in the form? Please re-send the contact form with your correct email address. Depending on Internet conditions, there may be a delay in our receipt of your email.
